root_cause_label: Model Unnecessarily Attempted Binary File Read Causing Runtime Crash
one_sentence_failure_summary: The model chose to read a binary PNG file using the text read tool, which crashed the agent runtime due to resource constraints, terminating the trajectory before any implementation began.
t_err_evidence: Step 3: agent issues '[read] /app/demo_rgb.png' on a binary PNG file using a text-read tool; this is both unnecessary (the task requires writing a script, not inspecting the image) and directly triggers the runtime crash.
t_commit_evidence: Step 3: the runtime crashes immediately upon the binary read attempt ('The runtime system may have crashed and restarted due to resource constraints'), locking in failure with no further steps possible.
t_surface_evidence: Step 3 terminal output: 'The action has not been executed due to a runtime error. The runtime system may have crashed and restarted due to resource constraints.'
trigger_explanation: The model lacked the domain knowledge that attempting to read a binary image file with a text/read tool would crash the agent runtime. The model had already gathered sufficient structural information from the CSV in step 2; reading the PNG was both unnecessary and fatally harmful to the runtime environment.
